verdict.rationale: The cited INPI pages describe online filing of trademarks, patents, designs, e-Soleau and similar procedures, but none documents a way to start a filing without first creating an account, nor a file-number or keyless entry path. The only access-related item is a probe showing data.inpi.fr refuses keyless requests and requires an account-issued token, which points the other way, though it concerns the data portal rather than the filing flow itself.
